name: Oak Hill Outdoor Center
description: Oak Hill Outdoor Center is focused on providing high-quality XC skiing. Conveniently located in Hanover, NH, we feature 25 km of groomed skiing and 3.5 km of snowmaking with lights. The Welcome Center is open from 8:30 am to 4:30 pm; Lights are on until 8:00 pm. https://www.oakhilloutdoorcenter.org/
